heldItem.description: Test Sitrus Berry. Restores 25% HP at half health or below.
Test Miracle Seed. Increases Grass-type move damage by 20%.
Test Choice Scarf. Raises Speed by 50% but locks the first selected move during combat.
Test Focus Sash. At full HP, survives direct lethal move damage with 1 HP.
Test Leftovers. Restores 1/16 max HP every 3 seconds during combat.
